				OR = {

	}

# anb_scripted_triggers/anb_building_requirement_triggers.txt
building_winemaking_requirement_terrain = {
	aov_rie_vanilla_building_ground_trigger = yes # Anbennar Overhaul: no vanilla building for a dwarf on dwarven ground
	is_county_capital = yes
	OR = {
		AND = { #Lorent + Pearlsedge
			OR = {
				terrain = farmlands
				terrain = plains
				terrain = hills
			}
			geographical_region = lorent_winegrowing_region
		}
		AND = { #Bulwar
			OR = {
				terrain = floodplains
				terrain = farmlands
				terrain = hills
			}
			geographical_region = bulwar_winegrowing_region
		}
		
		OR = { #Hardcoded Exceptions
			geographical_region = special_winegrowing_region
		}
	}
}
